extracted.intended_audience: CIA ADP Control Officers and agency staff responsible for ADP procurement and OMB Circular A-76 compliance
extracted.subtask_short: applying OMB Circular A-76 to ADP
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for applying OMB Circular A-76 to government automated data processing (ADP) requirements, covering when to use commercial services, security constraints that may bar outsourcing, and internal reporting procedures. Aimed at ADP control officers and procurement/management staff implementing or evaluating outsourcing alternatives under the Circular.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preference for commercial services when possible
rubrics_metrics.description: Use commercial services whenever possible when implementing ADP products and programs, in keeping with the general desire expressed in the draft transmittal memorandum to OMB Circular A-76.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Agency's planned FY 1978 ADP program analysis showed that approximately 70 percent of ADP dollars go to commercial sources and the Agency regularly considers contracting out when weighing alternative methods of implementing ADP programs. Treat use of commercial services as a default option to be considered in program implementation decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protect sources, methods, and sensitive information
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognize that protection of the Agency's sources and methods, and sensitive information provided by other organizations, can preclude use of external/commercial services for certain ADP requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Security and protection obligations may override the general preference for commercial services; when such protection is required, the Agency must refrain from outsourcing those functions or data to external providers. Explicitly evaluate security/sensitivity constraints as a disqualifying factor in outsourcing decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Continue internal reporting on matters covered by Circular A-76
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintain reporting to the Agency's internal examiner/oversight on matters covered by OMB Circular A-76 despite coordination or transfer of action among offices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Agency plans to continue reporting directly to its OI s.IB Examiner on matters covered by the circular even when responsibility for coordination is transferred (e.g., from ODP to the Comptroller). Ensure procedural reporting obligations to internal oversight are observed during implementation and coordination.
